name: 07660 · Ridgefield Pk, NJ
findings: ZIP 07660 (Ridgefield Pk) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07660 (Ridgefield Pk) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07660 (Ridgefield Pk) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
